maya: quick sync on quant benchmarking methodology. seeing inconsistent perf when switching kernels + INT8 calibration. want to settle a fair protocol (warmup, power caps, tokenization, KV state) before we publish numbers. key issues: kernel selection flips between runs, calibration altering runtimes, KV cache warmup effects, and tokenizer differences. thoughts?

samir: +1. proposal: pin kernel hints, standardize warmup tokens to 512, run power-capped experiments, and separate calibration step from perf measurement. example run:
```
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=int8_fast
export MAX_WARMUP_TOKENS=512
nvidia-smi -pl 175
python bench.py \
  --model /mnt/models/llama-13b-quantized \
  --seq 2048 --tokens 2048 --seed 42 \
  --calibrate /tmp/calib.json \
  --warmup-tokens $MAX_WARMUP_TOKENS
```
Measure p50/p95/p99 plus tokens/sec and energy.

natalie: agree on power-capping. add: use `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw --format=csv` sample window after stabilization. for kv cache: do 3 priming passes of the prompt corpus, then reset counters, then run measured passes. document whether we include cache-warmed numbers or cold-start.

leah: uploaded profiling sample showing where kernel selector flipped post-calibration, and an INT8 matmul slow path. log excerpt:
```
[1769992251][kernel-select] layer 0-6 -> fp8_fused_attn
[1769992251][kernel-select] layer 7-12 -> int8_matmul (fallback)
[kv] priming_passes=1 hit_rate=0.04
[kv] priming_passes=3 hit_rate=0.31
[perf] int8_matmul latency 1.18x vs fp8 baseline after calib
```
If calibration changes scaling factors per-layer we might trigger different codepaths; need to capture kernel names per-layer in the run metadata.

ryan: tokenization: lock to the exact sentencepiece/vocab snapshot. run `python -m tokenizers dump --model ...` and store checksums. also define cold vs hot KV: cold = start from clean KV state, hot = after N full prefix passes. do both and report both. add golden prompts list + fixed RNG seed for sampling.

bench-bot: nightly summary: https://internal.redwood/bench/nightly/2026-03-02/quant-summary : int8_throughput regressed 12% on 13b compared to previous baseline; calibration step accounted for 70% of the regression.

maya: plan ->
- formalize bench protocol doc (kernel pinning, warmup=512, power=175W, tokenizer checksum)
- separate calibration job (produce calib artifact) and record per-layer kernel choices
- measure cold/hot KV with 3 priming runs and report both
- include p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and energy usage
- automate verification: bench CI that fails if delta >5% unrelated to known changes

samir: ack :+1:

natalie: I'll add `nvidia-smi` sampling script and a short README for the KV priming steps

leah: I'll attach the per-layer kernel dump from last run in the doc and open a perf PR for the INT8 path

maya: thanks all — I'll draft the protocol and share PR by EOD. next sync in #eng-ml on Friday.
